user_query: I'm planning a surprise anniversary party for my parents and I want to send them some sweet messages. Can you provide me with unlimited sweet messages from the Messages API? Also, retrieve the message replies history from the sms77io API to keep track of any responses. Finally, fetch the existing webhooks from the sms77io API to ensure we receive important notifications about the party.

TaskList.description: Retrieve unlimited sweet messages from the Messages API.
Fetch the message replies history from the sms77io API to track responses.
Fetch existing webhooks from the sms77io API to receive important notifications.
